in_marathi.name: Anwesha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anwesha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anwesha is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'an' meaning 'towards' and 'vesha' meaning 'dwelling' or 'abode'. It symbolizes the deep longing or desire one has for something or someone. In Hindu mythology, Anwesha is a form of goddess Parvati, who represents the power of desire and longing.
